title: FrameMeta
description: The first stage of the vision pipeline: which frame a camera produced (its id, the instant it was captured, its size and its pixel format). The detections of the next stage name this frame by frame_id. The schema is closed.

frame_id.description: The frame, unique within its session.

capture_ts_utc.description: When the camera captured the frame.

pixel_format.description: How the pixels are laid out; JPEG is a compressed frame.

session_id.description: The capture session the frame belongs to.

stride.description: Bytes per row of a packed format, when rows are padded.

sequence.description: Grows with every frame of a session.
